meta.scope: Myanmar Batch 3 — Poverty/living standards, exchange-rate regime, and jade/minerals densification under constrained conditions.

candidates.title: Poverty and living standards statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from World Bank-aligned and national monitoring sources
candidates.description: Poverty rates and living-standards indicators. Poverty had declined substantially before 2021; subsequent conflict, economic contraction and displacement have reversed gains and elevated vulnerability, especially in conflict-affected areas.
candidates.notes: Core welfare measurement node under elevated stress conditions.

candidates.title: Exchange-rate regime and parallel-market statistics
candidates.publisher: Central Bank of Myanmar / parallel-market trackers
candidates.description: Official and parallel-market exchange rates for the kyat. Multiple rates and a persistent parallel-market premium are structural features under currency controls, limited FX availability and elevated inflation.
candidates.notes: Critical price and external-constraint node. Parallel-market premium is a key signal.

candidates.title: Jade and gemstone production / export framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from trade and sector sources
candidates.description: Framing and available statistics on jade and gemstone production and exports. Jade has historically been a major foreign-exchange and informal-economy activity, with strong China-linked demand and limited transparency.
candidates.notes: High-centrality informal and extractive densification. Data quality is particularly limited.

candidates.title: Myanmar poverty–exchange–jade densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from welfare, CBM and extractives sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding poverty and living-standards statistics, exchange-rate/parallel-market statistics, and jade/gemstone framing into a coherent welfare–monetary–extractive layer under constrained conditions.
